stemMarkdown: If 12 workers can complete a job in 12 days, how many days will 10 workers take to complete the same job, working at the same rate? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: The job needs $12 \times 12 = 144$ worker-days. With 10 workers that takes $\dfrac{144}{10} = 14.4$ days. Workers and days vary inversely.
